description: Free. Sellers who proved control of the wallet their x402 endpoints are paid to, with their published profile and endpoint counts. Use when: you want a contact or docs link for a seller, or to see which sellers stand behind their endpoints. Not for: judging an endpoint’s quality (claims never change scores; use settled_check). Paged: limit (max 50) and offset, with a total.

offset.description: How many sellers to skip, for paging (default 0)

name: settled_sellers

attestation.description: EIP-191 signature over the answer; verify it with settled_verify or any EVM library

error.description: Present only when the call failed or needs another step: an error code such as pass_required, next to the fields that explain it

sellers.description: Claimed sellers with their profile and endpoint counts

title: Claimed sellers
